name: Having A Christmas Tree
overview: The Scriptures point to the coming of Christ as the true sign from the Lord, fulfilled in the virgin birth and the promised Branch from Jesse's roots, highlighting God's redemptive plan (Isaiah 7:14; 11:1). Jeremiah warns God's people to avoid adopting the customs and signs of the heathen, urging discernment in practices that may not honor Him (Jeremiah 10:1-2). The shepherds' watch over their flocks at night and the provision of heavenly bread emphasize Christ as the true source of life and hope (Luke 2:8; John 6:50). Therefore, any tradition, including having a Christmas tree, must be carefully weighed against these biblical principles to ensure it points to Christ and not to worldly customs.
